purpose: Fourth exact rerun of the fully supervised GT reference pipeline after a collaborator obtained a different result from a similar experiment.
scientific_role: fully supervised reference reproducibility and stability audit only; never a WSL result

execution.reason: An exact byte-identical rerun isolates stochastic/runtime variation from implementation or configuration drift.

training_contract.augmentation: paired random horizontal flip p=0.5 on train only
training_contract.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation tumor-only Dice at threshold 0.5; tie-break by normal empty-mask specificity within Dice tolerance 0.0001

evaluation_contract.primary_population: all 184 validation tumor images including complete misses

audit_plan: verify exact wrapper, frozen source, split and pretrained-weight hashes
verify complete train and validation cohorts and test lock
recompute checkpoint and threshold selection from retained logs and per-image predictions
compare run v4 against frozen reference, independent v2 and independent v3
quantify paired complete-group differences overall and by the fixed 94/72/18 lesion-size subgroups
separate contract drift from stochastic optimization instability
retain environment versions, selected checkpoint hash and compact evidence
interpretation_rule: The hash-locked frozen GT reference is not replaced by this post-observation rerun. V4 is sensitivity evidence. Any collaborator comparison is valid only after matching split hash, cohort, metric population, threshold rule, architecture, pretrained initialization, loss, image size and checkpoint-selection contract.
